    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Roslyn生成DTO及影子编程的尝试</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		<div class="postText">    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        Roslyn支持源生成器机制大大扩展了.net的能力,大量的重复、固定和稳定的代码都可以交给源生成器
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="1-dto含有大量重复代码">1. DTO含有大量重复代码</h2>
<h3 id="11-实体类comment代码如下">1.1 实体类Comment代码如下</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 评论
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
/// &lt;param name="id"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
/// &lt;param name="createTime"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
public class Comment(CommentId id, CommentCreateTime createTime)
{
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 评论标识
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public CommentId Id { get; } = id;
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 评论内容
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public CommentContent Content { get; set; }
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 评论创建时间
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public CommentCreateTime CreateTime { get; } = createTime;
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 评论更新时间
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public CommentUpdateTime UpdateTime { get; set; }
}
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 评论标识
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
/// &lt;param name="Original"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
public readonly record struct CommentId(long Original) : IEntityId;
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 评论内容
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
/// &lt;param name="Original"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
public readonly record struct CommentContent(string Original) : IEntityProperty&lt;string&gt;;
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 评论创建时间
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
/// &lt;param name="Original"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
public readonly record struct CommentCreateTime(DateTime Original) : IEntityProperty&lt;DateTime&gt;;
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 评论更新时间
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
/// &lt;param name="Original"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
public readonly record struct CommentUpdateTime(DateTime Original) : IEntityProperty&lt;DateTime&gt;;
</code></pre>
<h3 id="12-该curd的dto类型可能就会有很多重复代码">1.2 该CURD的DTO类型可能就会有很多重复代码</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>该示例有9个DTO类与Comment有同名属性</li>
<li>请查看示例的<a href="https://github.com/donetsoftwork/GeneratePocoDemo" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">github代码库</a></li>
<li><a href="https://gitee.com/donetsoftwork/GeneratePocoDemo" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">gitee代码库</a>也同步更新</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public sealed class CreateRequest
{
    public string Content { get; set; }
}
public sealed class CreateResponse : ResponseBase
{
    public long Id { get; set; }
}
public sealed class DeleteRequest
{
    public long Id { get; set; }
}
public sealed class DeleteResponse : ResponseBase
{
    public long Id { get; set; }
}
public sealed class UpdateRequest
{
    public long Id { get; set; }
}
public sealed class UpdateResponse : ResponseBase
{
    public long Id { get; set; }
}
public sealed class DetailRequest
{
    public long Id { get; set; }
}
public sealed class DetailResponse : ResponseBase
{
    public long Id { get; set; }
    public string Content { get; set; }
    public DateTime CreateTime { get; set; }
    public DateTime UpdateTime { get; set; }
}
public sealed class ListRequest
{
    public int Page { get; set; } = 1;
    public int Size { get; set; } = 10;
}
public sealed class ListResponse : ResponseBase
{
    public int Total { get; set; }
    public CommentItem[] Items { get; set; }
}
public class CommentItem
{
    public long Id { get; set; }
    public string Content { get; set; }
    public DateTime CreateTime { get; set; }
    public DateTime UpdateTime { get; set; }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="13-使用代码生成器可以减少重复代码">1.3 使用代码生成器可以减少重复代码</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>如下开源项目GeneratePoco生成器为5个DTO类生成属性,节省了大量重复代码</li>
<li>如果属性太少生成器的收益不大</li>
<li>GeneratePoco的泛型参数标记了该类型与哪个实体类相关联,也就是说是哪个类型的附属类或者影子类</li>
<li>通过ConvertFrom和ConvertTo配置是否生成从实体类到DTO的转换方法,或者从DTO到实体类的转换方法</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">[GeneratePoco&lt;Comment&gt;(ConvertFrom = true, ConvertTo = false)]
public partial class CreateResponse : ResponseBase;
[GeneratePoco&lt;Comment&gt;(Rules = [$"Include: {nameof(Comment.Id)}"], ConvertTo = false)]
public partial class DeleteResponse : ResponseBase;
[GeneratePoco&lt;Comment&gt;(Rules = [$"Include: {nameof(Comment.Id)}"], ConvertTo = false)]
public partial class UpdateResponse : ResponseBase;
[GeneratePoco&lt;Comment&gt;(ConvertFrom = true, ConvertTo = false)]
public partial class DetailResponse : ResponseBase;
[GeneratePoco&lt;Comment&gt;(ConvertFrom = true, ConvertTo = false)]
public partial class CommentItem;
</code></pre>
<h3 id="14-生成代码如下">1.4 生成代码如下</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>由源实体的强类型属性生成基本类型的DTO属性,是GeneratePoco的应用场景之一</li>
<li>ConvertFrom的方法生成为源类型的静态扩展方法</li>
<li>ConvertTo的方法生成为目标类型的实例方法</li>
<li>如果源类型属性有注释，生成的DTO属性也会包含相应的注释</li>
<li>如果DTO属性名与源类型属性名不一致，可以通过Rules配置,参看<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/19942266" target="_blank">SourceGenerator之扑风捉影</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">namespace GenerateApp.Create
{
    partial class CreateResponse
    {
        ///&lt;summary&gt;
        ///评论标识
        ///&lt;/summary&gt;
        public long Id { get; set; }
        ///&lt;summary&gt;
        ///评论内容
        ///&lt;/summary&gt;
        public string Content { get; set; }
        ///&lt;summary&gt;
        ///评论创建时间
        ///&lt;/summary&gt;
        public DateTime CreateTime { get; set; }
        ///&lt;summary&gt;
        ///评论更新时间
        ///&lt;/summary&gt;
        public DateTime UpdateTime { get; set; }
    }
}
namespace CommentModels
{
    using GenerateApp.Create;
    internal static partial class CommentExtensions
    {
        ///&lt;summary&gt;
        ///转化
        ///&lt;/summary&gt;
        ///&lt;param name = "message"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
        public static CreateResponse ToCreateResponse(this Comment @this) =&gt; new()
        {
            Id = @this.Id.Original,
            Content = @this.Content.Original,
            CreateTime = @this.CreateTime.Original,
            UpdateTime = @this.UpdateTime.Original
        };
    }
}
namespace GenerateApp.Delete
{
    partial class DeleteResponse
    {
        ///&lt;summary&gt;
        ///评论标识
        ///&lt;/summary&gt;
        public long Id { get; set; }
    }
}
namespace GenerateApp.Update
{
    partial class UpdateResponse
    {
        ///&lt;summary&gt;
        ///评论标识
        ///&lt;/summary&gt;
        public long Id { get; set; }
    }
}
namespace GenerateApp.Detail
{
    partial class DetailResponse
    {
        ///&lt;summary&gt;
        ///评论标识
        ///&lt;/summary&gt;
        public long Id { get; set; }
        ///&lt;summary&gt;
        ///评论内容
        ///&lt;/summary&gt;
        public string Content { get; set; }
        ///&lt;summary&gt;
        ///评论创建时间
        ///&lt;/summary&gt;
        public DateTime CreateTime { get; set; }
        ///&lt;summary&gt;
        ///评论更新时间
        ///&lt;/summary&gt;
        public DateTime UpdateTime { get; set; }
    }
}
namespace CommentModels
{
    using GenerateApp.Detail;
    internal static partial class CommentExtensions
    {
        ///&lt;summary&gt;
        ///转化
        ///&lt;/summary&gt;
        ///&lt;param name = "message"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
        public static DetailResponse ToDetailResponse(this Comment @this) =&gt; new()
        {
            Id = @this.Id.Original,
            Content = @this.Content.Original,
            CreateTime = @this.CreateTime.Original,
            UpdateTime = @this.UpdateTime.Original
        };
    }
}
namespace GenerateApp.List
{
    partial class CommentItem
    {
        ///&lt;summary&gt;
        ///评论标识
        ///&lt;/summary&gt;
        public long Id { get; set; }
        ///&lt;summary&gt;
        ///评论内容
        ///&lt;/summary&gt;
        public string Content { get; set; }
        ///&lt;summary&gt;
        ///评论创建时间
        ///&lt;/summary&gt;
        public DateTime CreateTime { get; set; }
        ///&lt;summary&gt;
        ///评论更新时间
        ///&lt;/summary&gt;
        public DateTime UpdateTime { get; set; }
    }
}
namespace CommentModels
{
    using GenerateApp.List;
    internal static partial class CommentExtensions
    {
        ///&lt;summary&gt;
        ///转化
        ///&lt;/summary&gt;
        public static CommentItem ToItem(this Comment @this) =&gt; new()
        {
            Id = @this.Id.Original,
            Content = @this.Content.Original,
            CreateTime = @this.CreateTime.Original,
            UpdateTime = @this.UpdateTime.Original
        };
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="15-应用业务逻辑">1.5 应用业务逻辑</h3>
<h3 id="151-原始的业务逻辑代码">1.5.1 原始的业务逻辑代码</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">    private readonly ICommentService _service = service;

    public override Task&lt;CreateResponse&gt; ExecuteAsync(CreateRequest req, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var content = new CommentContent(req.Content);
        var comment = _service.AddComment(content);
        var res = new CreateResponse()
        {
            Id = comment.Id.Original,
            Content = comment.Content.Original,
            CreateTime = comment.CreateTime.Original,
            UpdateTime = comment.UpdateTime.Original,
        };
        return Task.FromResult(res);
    }
</code></pre>
<h3 id="152-使用代码生成的dto的业务逻辑代码">1.5.2 使用代码生成的DTO的业务逻辑代码</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>GeneratePoco生成的类型转化方法代替了Mapper,简化了业务逻辑代码</li>
<li>开源项目GeneratePoco的Mapper功能是通过引用开源项目GenerateConvert来实现的</li>
<li>GenerateConvert本身可以单独用来生成Mapper代码,有点类似开源项目mapperly</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">    private readonly ICommentService _service = service;

    public override Task&lt;CreateResponse&gt; ExecuteAsync(CreateRequest req, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var content = new CommentContent(req.Content);
        var comment = _service.AddComment(content);
        return Task.FromResult(comment.ToCreateResponse());
    }
</code></pre>
<h3 id="16-roslyn生成dto现存的问题">1.6 Roslyn生成DTO现存的问题</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>生成器执行顺序问题</li>
<li>DTO可以通过JsonSourceGenerator生成序列化的代码来提高性能和AOT支持等</li>
<li>但是JsonSourceGenerator的执行顺序在GeneratePoco之前,生成的序列化代码不包含GeneratePoco生成的属性</li>
<li>所以使用GeneratePoco的类型不能使用JsonSourceGenerator生成器</li>
<li>这个问题将来某个时间微软应该会解决</li>
<li>暂时我也没有找到解决方案</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="17-以上示例代码已经上传到github可以直接查看">1.7 以上示例代码已经上传到github,可以直接查看</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://github.com/donetsoftwork/GeneratePocoDemo" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/donetsoftwork/GeneratePocoDemo</a></li>
<li>gitee同步跟新: <a href="https://gitee.com/donetsoftwork/GeneratePocoDemo" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/donetsoftwork/GeneratePocoDemo</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="2-可以用generateconvert来做类型转化">2. 可以用GenerateConvert来做类型转化</h2>
<h4 id="21-转化为dto的case">2.1 转化为DTO的Case</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Car转化为CarDto</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="211-car及相关类">2.1.1 Car及相关类</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public class Car
{
    public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public int NumberOfSeats { get; set; }
    public CarColor Color { get; set; }
    public Manufacturer? Manufacturer { get; set; }
    public List&lt;Tire&gt; Tires { get; set; } = [];
    public LicensePlate LicensePlate { get; set; }
}
public enum CarColor
{
    Black = 1,
    Blue = 2,
    White = 3,
}
public class Manufacturer(int id, string name)
{
    public int Id { get; } = id;
    public string Name { get; } = name;
}
public class Tire
{
    public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;
}
public readonly struct LicensePlate(string  value)
{
    public string Value { get;} = value;

    public override readonly string ToString() =&gt; Value;
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="211-cardto及相关类">2.1.1 CarDto及相关类</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public class CarDto
{
    public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public int NumberOfSeats { get; set; }
    public CarColorDto Color { get; set; }
    public ProducerDto? Producer { get; set; }
    public List&lt;TireDto&gt;? Tires { get; set; }
    public string LicensePlate { get; set; } = string.Empty;
}
public enum CarColorDto
{
    Yellow = 1,
    Green = 2,
    Black = 3,
    Blue = 4,
}
public class ProducerDto(int id, string name)
{
    public int Id { get; } = id;
    public string Name { get; } = name;
}
public class TireDto(string description)
{
    public string Description { get; set; } = description;
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="22-可以用generateconvert来做类型转化">2.2 可以用GenerateConvert来做类型转化</h4>
<h4 id="221-generateconvert配置代码">2.2.1 GenerateConvert配置代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>把CarDto设置为partial</li>
<li>增加GenerateConvert&lt;Car&gt;标记</li>
<li>配置ConvertFrom = true生成Car转化为</li>
<li>Rules配置同前面GeneratePoco的Rules,是通过投影规则定义成员映射规则</li>
<li>这里定义了CarDto的Producer隐射到Car的Manufacturer</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">[GenerateConvert&lt;Car&gt;(
    Rules = [
        $"Map {nameof(Producer)}, {nameof(Car.Manufacturer)}"
    ],
    ConvertTo = false,
    ConvertFrom = true
)]
public partial class CarDto
{
    public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public int NumberOfSeats { get; set; }
    public CarColorDto Color { get; set; }
    public ProducerDto? Producer { get; set; }
    public List&lt;TireDto&gt;? Tires { get; set; }
    public string LicensePlate { get; set; } = string.Empty;
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="222-generateconvert生成的代码">2.2.2 GenerateConvert生成的代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>生成了4个扩展方法</li>
<li>其中Car.ToDto是入口方法</li>
<li>这些方法都很简洁,几乎和手写的一样</li>
<li>每个方法都有summary注释</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">using ConvertDemo.Models;

internal static partial class CarExtensions
{
    ///&lt;summary&gt;
    ///转化为CarDto
    ///&lt;/summary&gt;
    public static CarDto ToDto(this Car @this) =&gt; new()
    {
        Name = @this.Name,
        NumberOfSeats = @this.NumberOfSeats,
        Color = @this.Color.ToDto(),
        Producer = @this.Manufacturer == null ? default : @this.Manufacturer.ToProducerDto(),
        Tires = @this.Tires.ConvertAll(item =&gt; item.ToDto()),
        LicensePlate = @this.LicensePlate.Value
    };
}
internal static partial class CarColorExtensions
{
    ///&lt;summary&gt;
    ///转化为CarColorDto
    ///&lt;/summary&gt;
    public static CarColorDto ToDto(this CarColor @this) =&gt; @this switch
    {
        CarColor.Black =&gt; CarColorDto.Black,
        CarColor.Blue =&gt; CarColorDto.Blue,
        _ =&gt; default
    };
}
internal static partial class ManufacturerExtensions
{
    ///&lt;summary&gt;
    ///转化为ProducerDto
    ///&lt;/summary&gt;
    public static ProducerDto? ToProducerDto(this Manufacturer @this) =&gt; new(@this.Id, @this.Name);
}
internal static partial class TireExtensions
{
    ///&lt;summary&gt;
    ///转化为TireDto
    ///&lt;/summary&gt;
    public static TireDto ToDto(this Tire @this) =&gt; new(@this.Description);
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="23-也可以用mapperly实现这个需求">2.3 也可以用mapperly实现这个需求</h4>
<h4 id="231-mapperly配置代码">2.3.1 mapperly配置代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>新建partial类CarMapper</li>
<li>增加Mapper特性配置</li>
<li>增加一个Car转化为CarDto的partial方法</li>
<li>通过MapProperty配置映射规则</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">[Mapper(EnumMappingStrategy = EnumMappingStrategy.ByName)]
public static partial class CarMapper
{
    [MapProperty(nameof(Car.Manufacturer), nameof(CarDto.Producer))] 
    public static partial CarDto MapCarToDto(Car car);
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="232-mapperly生成代码">2.3.2 mapperly生成代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>生成了5个静态方法</li>
<li>1个公开的入口,4个私有的静态方法,并不能单独使用</li>
<li>类名都用global+全命名空间</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public static partial class CarMapper
{
    [global::System.CodeDom.Compiler.GeneratedCode("Riok.Mapperly", "4.3.1.0")]
    public static partial global::MapperlyDemo.Models.CarDto MapCarToDto(global::Demo.Models.Car car)
    {
        var target = new global::MapperlyDemo.Models.CarDto();
        target.Name = car.Name;
        target.NumberOfSeats = car.NumberOfSeats;
        target.Color = MapToCarColorDto(car.Color);
        if (car.Manufacturer != null)
        {
            target.Producer = MapToProducerDto(car.Manufacturer);
        }
        else
        {
            target.Producer = null;
        }
        target.Tires = MapToListOfTireDto(car.Tires);
        target.LicensePlate = car.LicensePlate.ToString();
        return target;
    }

    [global::System.CodeDom.Compiler.GeneratedCode("Riok.Mapperly", "4.3.1.0")]
    private static global::MapperlyDemo.Models.CarColorDto MapToCarColorDto(global::Demo.Models.CarColor source)
    {
        return source switch
        {
            global::Demo.Models.CarColor.Black =&gt; global::MapperlyDemo.Models.CarColorDto.Black,
            global::Demo.Models.CarColor.Blue =&gt; global::MapperlyDemo.Models.CarColorDto.Blue,
            _ =&gt; throw new global::System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(source), source, "The value of enum CarColor is not supported"),
        };
    }

    [global::System.CodeDom.Compiler.GeneratedCode("Riok.Mapperly", "4.3.1.0")]
    private static global::MapperlyDemo.Models.ProducerDto MapToProducerDto(global::Demo.Models.Manufacturer source)
    {
        var target = new global::MapperlyDemo.Models.ProducerDto(source.Id, source.Name);
        return target;
    }

    [global::System.CodeDom.Compiler.GeneratedCode("Riok.Mapperly", "4.3.1.0")]
    private static global::MapperlyDemo.Models.TireDto MapToTireDto(global::Demo.Models.Tire source)
    {
        var target = new global::MapperlyDemo.Models.TireDto();
        target.Description = source.Description;
        return target;
    }

    [global::System.CodeDom.Compiler.GeneratedCode("Riok.Mapperly", "4.3.1.0")]
    private static global::System.Collections.Generic.List&lt;global::MapperlyDemo.Models.TireDto&gt; MapToListOfTireDto(global::System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyCollection&lt;global::Demo.Models.Tire&gt; source)
    {
        var target = new global::System.Collections.Generic.List&lt;global::MapperlyDemo.Models.TireDto&gt;(source.Count);
        foreach (var item in source)
        {
            target.Add(MapToTireDto(item));
        }
        return target;
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="24-用generateconvert实现互转">2.4 用GenerateConvert实现互转</h4>
<h4 id="241-generateconvert互转配置代码">2.4.1 GenerateConvert互转配置代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>与2.2示例唯一区别就是ConvertTo配置为true</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">[GenerateConvert&lt;Car&gt;(
    Rules = [
        $"Map {nameof(Producer)}, {nameof(Car.Manufacturer)}"
    ],
    ConvertTo = true,
    ConvertFrom = true
)]
public partial class CarDto
{
    public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public int NumberOfSeats { get; set; }
    public CarColorDto Color { get; set; }
    public ProducerDto? Producer { get; set; }
    public List&lt;TireDto&gt;? Tires { get; set; }
    public string LicensePlate { get; set; } = string.Empty;
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="242-generateconvert互转生成的代码">2.4.2 GenerateConvert互转生成的代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>比2.2示例多生成以下4个方法</li>
<li>其中2个实例方法2个扩展方法</li>
<li>如果转化源类为当前程序集的partial类就会生成实例方法,否则生成扩展方法</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">namespace ConvertDemo.Models;
partial class CarDto
{
    ///&lt;summary&gt;
    ///转化为Car
    ///&lt;/summary&gt;
    public Car ToCar() =&gt; new()
    {
        Name = Name,
        NumberOfSeats = NumberOfSeats,
        Color = Color.ToCarColor(),
        Manufacturer = Producer == null ? default : Producer.ToManufacturer(),
        Tires = Tires == null ? [] : Tires.ConvertAll(item =&gt; item.ToTire()),
        LicensePlate = new LicensePlate(LicensePlate)
    };
}
public static partial class CarColorDtoExtensions
{
    ///&lt;summary&gt;
    ///转化为CarColor
    ///&lt;/summary&gt;
    public static CarColor ToCarColor(this CarColorDto @this) =&gt; @this switch
    {
        CarColorDto.Black =&gt; CarColor.Black,
        CarColorDto.Blue =&gt; CarColor.Blue,
        _ =&gt; default
    };
}
partial class ProducerDto
{
    ///&lt;summary&gt;
    ///转化为Manufacturer
    ///&lt;/summary&gt;
    public Manufacturer? ToManufacturer() =&gt; new(Id, Name);
}
public static partial class TireDtoExtensions
{
    ///&lt;summary&gt;
    ///转化为Tire
    ///&lt;/summary&gt;
    public static Tire ToTire(this TireDto @this) =&gt; new()
    {
        Description = @this.Description
    };
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="25-用mapperly实现互转">2.5 用mapperly实现互转</h4>
<h4 id="251-mapperly互转配置代码">2.5.1 mapperly互转配置代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>比2.3示例多1个方法MapDtoToCar及其MapProperty特性配置</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">[Mapper(EnumMappingStrategy = EnumMappingStrategy.ByName)]
public static partial class CarMapper
{
    [MapProperty(nameof(Car.Manufacturer), nameof(CarDto.Producer))]
    public static partial CarDto MapCarToDto(Car car);

    [MapProperty(nameof(CarDto.Producer), nameof(Car.Manufacturer))]
    public static partial Car MapDtoToCar(CarDto car);
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="252-mapperly互转生成代码">2.5.2 mapperly互转生成代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>比2.3示例多生成了5个静态方法</li>
<li>其中1个公开的入口方法及4个私有的静态方法</li>
<li>类名都用global+全命名空间</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public static partial class CarMapper
{
    [global::System.CodeDom.Compiler.GeneratedCode("Riok.Mapperly", "4.3.1.0")]
    public static partial global::Demo.Models.Car MapDtoToCar(global::MapperlyDemo.Models.CarDto car)
    {
        var target = new global::Demo.Models.Car();
        target.Name = car.Name;
        target.NumberOfSeats = car.NumberOfSeats;
        target.Color = MapToCarColor(car.Color);
        if (car.Producer != null)
        {
            target.Manufacturer = MapToManufacturer(car.Producer);
        }
        else
        {
            target.Manufacturer = null;
        }
        if (car.Tires != null)
        {
            target.Tires = MapToListOfTire(car.Tires);
        }
        target.LicensePlate = new global::Demo.Models.LicensePlate(car.LicensePlate);
        return target;
    }
    
    [global::System.CodeDom.Compiler.GeneratedCode("Riok.Mapperly", "4.3.1.0")]
    private static global::Demo.Models.CarColor MapToCarColor(global::MapperlyDemo.Models.CarColorDto source)
    {
        return source switch
        {
            global::MapperlyDemo.Models.CarColorDto.Black =&gt; global::Demo.Models.CarColor.Black,
            global::MapperlyDemo.Models.CarColorDto.Blue =&gt; global::Demo.Models.CarColor.Blue,
            _ =&gt; throw new global::System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(source), source, "The value of enum CarColorDto is not supported"),
        };
    }
    
    [global::System.CodeDom.Compiler.GeneratedCode("Riok.Mapperly", "4.3.1.0")]
    private static global::Demo.Models.Manufacturer MapToManufacturer(global::MapperlyDemo.Models.ProducerDto source)
    {
        var target = new global::Demo.Models.Manufacturer(source.Id, source.Name);
        return target;
    }
    
    [global::System.CodeDom.Compiler.GeneratedCode("Riok.Mapperly", "4.3.1.0")]
    private static global::Demo.Models.Tire MapToTire(global::MapperlyDemo.Models.TireDto source)
    {
        var target = new global::Demo.Models.Tire();
        target.Description = source.Description;
        return target;
    }
    
    [global::System.CodeDom.Compiler.GeneratedCode("Riok.Mapperly", "4.3.1.0")]
    private static global::System.Collections.Generic.List&lt;global::Demo.Models.Tire&gt; MapToListOfTire(global::System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyCollection&lt;global::MapperlyDemo.Models.TireDto&gt; source)
    {
        var target = new global::System.Collections.Generic.List&lt;global::Demo.Models.Tire&gt;(source.Count);
        foreach (var item in source)
        {
            target.Add(MapToTire(item));
        }
        return target;
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="26-generateconvert和mapperly的对比">2.6 GenerateConvert和mapperly的对比</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>以下是GenerateConvert和mapperly的对比,你喜欢哪种</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="261-命名空间处理">2.6.1 命名空间处理</h4>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>特性</th>
<th style="text-align: left">GenerateConvert</th>
<th style="text-align: left">mapperly</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>同名类处理</td>
<td style="text-align: left">有同名类型才增加命名空间</td>
<td style="text-align: left">直接global+命名空间+类名，不用单独处理</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>引用</td>
<td style="text-align: left">把命名空间提取为using</td>
<td style="text-align: left">无using</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>简洁性</td>
<td style="text-align: left">更好</td>
<td style="text-align: left">大量重复代码</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>准确性</td>
<td style="text-align: left">同名类且命名空间包含可能导致错误</td>
<td style="text-align: left">同名类只要命名空间不完全相同就不会出错</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h4 id="262-映射配置">2.6.2 映射配置</h4>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>特性</th>
<th style="text-align: left">GenerateConvert</th>
<th style="text-align: left">mapperly</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>完善性</td>
<td style="text-align: left">支持同名、前缀、后缀、替换、一对一等及Filter、Through和Cross投影</td>
<td style="text-align: left">同名、一对一、忽略等</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>复用性</td>
<td style="text-align: left">互转可共用配置且与集成的GeneratePoco共用</td>
<td style="text-align: left">每个转化方法单独配置</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h4 id="263-调用方法">2.6.3 调用方法</h4>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>特性</th>
<th style="text-align: left">GenerateConvert</th>
<th style="text-align: left">mapperly</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>入口方法</td>
<td style="text-align: left">实例方法或扩展方法,按实例调用</td>
<td style="text-align: left">调用Mapper的方法</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>辅助方法</td>
<td style="text-align: left">也是方法或扩展方法,按实例调用</td>
<td style="text-align: left">私有,不可单独调用</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="27-generateconvert项目信息">2.7 GenerateConvert项目信息</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>nuget dotnet add package Hand.GenerateConvert --version 0.2.1.17-alpha</li>
<li>github <a href="https://github.com/donetsoftwork/Hand.Generators/tree/master/Hand.GenerateConvert" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/donetsoftwork/Hand.Generators/tree/master/Hand.GenerateConvert</a></li>
<li>gitee <a href="https://gitee.com/donetsoftwork/hand.-generators/tree/master/Hand.GenerateConvert" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/donetsoftwork/hand.-generators/tree/master/Hand.GenerateConvert</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="3-更多生成器的应用">3. 更多生成器的应用</h2>
<h3 id="31-generatepoco生成构造函数">3.1 GeneratePoco生成构造函数</h3>
<h4 id="311-生成构造函数默认样式">3.1.1 生成构造函数默认样式</h4>
<h5 id="3111-配置代码">3.1.1.1 配置代码</h5>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Initializer配置为InitializeKind.Constructor</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public record User(int Id, string Name);
[GeneratePoco&lt;User&gt;(Initializer = InitializeKind.Constructor)]
public partial class UserDto;
</code></pre>
<h5 id="3112-生成代码">3.1.1.2 生成代码</h5>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">partial class UserDto(int id, string name)
{
    public int Id { get; } = id;
    public string Name { get; } = name;
    public User ToUser() =&gt; new(Id, Name);
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="312-生成构造函数含字段样式">3.1.2 生成构造函数含字段样式</h4>
<h5 id="3121-配置代码">3.1.2.1 配置代码</h5>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Initializer配置为InitializeKind.Constructor | InitializeKind.Field</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public record User(int Id, string Name);
[GeneratePoco&lt;User&gt;(Initializer = InitializeKind.Constructor | InitializeKind.Field)]
public partial class UserDto;
</code></pre>
<h5 id="3122-生成代码">3.1.2.2 生成代码</h5>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">partial class UserDto(int id, string name)
{
    private readonly int _id = id;
    private readonly string _name = name;
    public int Id =&gt; _id;
    public string Name =&gt; _name;
    public User ToUser() =&gt; new(_id, _name);
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="313-生成构造函数设置属性样式">3.1.3 生成构造函数设置属性样式</h4>
<h5 id="3131-配置代码">3.1.3.1 配置代码</h5>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Initializer配置为InitializeKind.Constructor | InitializeKind.Property</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public record User(int Id, string Name);
[GeneratePoco&lt;User&gt;(Initializer = InitializeKind.Constructor | InitializeKind.Property)]
public partial class UserDto;
</code></pre>
<h5 id="3132-生成代码">3.1.3.2 生成代码</h5>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">partial class UserDto(int id, string name)
{
    public int Id { get; set; } = id;
    public string Name { get; set; } = name;
    public User ToUser() =&gt; new(Id, Name);
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="314-生成构造函数设置字段及属性样式">3.1.4 生成构造函数设置字段及属性样式</h4>
<h5 id="3141-配置代码">3.1.4.1 配置代码</h5>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Initializer配置为InitializeKind.Constructor | InitializeKind.Property | InitializeKind.Field</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public record User(int Id, string Name);
[GeneratePoco&lt;User&gt;(Initializer = InitializeKind.Constructor | InitializeKind.Property | InitializeKind.Field)]
public partial class UserDto;
</code></pre>
<h5 id="3142-生成代码">3.1.4.2 生成代码</h5>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">partial class UserDto(int id, string name)
{
    private int _id = id;
    private string _name = name;
    public int Id { get =&gt; _id; set =&gt; _id = value; }
    public string Name { get =&gt; _name; set =&gt; _name = value; }
    public GeneratePocoTests.User ToUser() =&gt; new(_id, _name);
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="315-生成属性默认样式">3.1.5 生成属性默认样式</h4>

<h4 id="3110-生成记录样式">3.1.10 生成记录样式</h4>

[GeneratePoco&lt;User&gt;()]
public partial record UserDto;

{

}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="3111-generatepoco其他配置属性">3.1.11 GeneratePoco其他配置属性</h4>
<h4 id="31111-convertfromconvertto配置">3.1.11.1 ConvertFrom/ConvertTo配置</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ConvertFrom默认false,为true时生成从源类型到目标类型的静态扩展转换方法</li>
<li>ConvertTo默认true,为true时生成从目标类型到源类型的实例转换方法</li>
<li>前面已有生成两种方法的示例,这里不再赘述</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="31112-rules配置">3.1.11.2 Rules配置</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>从源类型到目标类型的属性映射规则</li>
<li>可以配置Include、Exclude等规则</li>
<li>参看<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/19942266" target="_blank">SourceGenerator之扑风捉影</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="31113-nullablerule配置">3.1.11.3 NullableRule配置</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>NullableRule配置哪些属性(及其相关的字段和参数)为可空类型</li>
<li>参看<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/19942266" target="_blank">SourceGenerator之扑风捉影</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="31114-generateattribute配置">3.1.11.4 GenerateAttribute配置</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>GenerateAttribute默认false,为true时源类型属性的特性会被复制到目标类型属性(及其相关的字段和参数)上</li>
<li>会判断源Attribute类型的AttributeUsage,是否适合应用到目标类型属性(及其相关的字段和参数)上,如果不适合则不会复制</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">// 配置代码
public class Product(int productId, string productName)
{
    public int ProductId { get; } = productId;
    [StringLength(100, MinimumLength = 6)]
    public string ProductName { get; } = productName;
}
[GeneratePoco&lt;Product&gt;(GenerateAttribute = true)]
public partial class ProductDto;
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">using GeneratePocoTests.Supports;
// 生成代码
partial class ProductDto
{
    public int ProductId { get; set; }

    [StringLength(100, MinimumLength = 6)]
    public string ProductName { get; set; }
    public Product ToProduct() =&gt; new(ProductId, ProductName);
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="31115-default配置">3.1.11.5 Default配置</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Default默认false,为true时生成默认默认值</li>
<li>同一个属性及其相关的字段和参数之一生成默认值</li>
<li>生成默认值的优先级是参数&gt;字段&gt;属性</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">// 配置代码
public record User(int Id, string Name);
[GeneratePoco&lt;User&gt;(Initializer = InitializeKind.Property | InitializeKind.Field, Default = true)]
public partial class UserDto;
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">// 生成代码
partial class UserDto
{
    private int _id = default;
    private string _name = "";
    public int Id { get =&gt; _id; set =&gt; _id = value; }
    public string Name { get =&gt; _name; set =&gt; _name = value; }
    public User ToUser() =&gt; new(_id, _name);
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="3112-generatepoco不只是生成dto">3.1.12 GeneratePoco不只是生成DTO</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>GeneratePoco实际上是生成十种不同的POCO类</li>
<li>这十种样式并不全适合DTO</li>
<li>也可以称之为影子类</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="32-generatetable生成器">3.2 GenerateTable生成器</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>GenerateTable生成器按实体类型生成表结构类</li>
<li>生成的表结构类可以用于生成数据库表,也可以用于对数据表进行增删改查等操作</li>
<li>一年前网友秦时明留言建议做源生成器,现在才补上会不会有点亡羊补牢的感觉</li>
<li>可以参看<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/18909458" target="_blank">ShadowSql.net之正确使用方式</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="321-generatetable配置代码">3.2.1 GenerateTable配置代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过Attribute配置表结构</li>
<li>Table配置表名</li>
<li>DatabaseGeneratedOption.Identity配置自增列</li>
<li>Key配置主键</li>
<li>Column配置了列名或数据库原始类型</li>
<li>Unique配置唯一索引(支持多列组合唯一)</li>
<li>需要引用ShadowSql.Core(0.9.2-alpha),否则无法生成代码</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">[Table("Products")]
public class Product(int id, string name)
{
    [Key]
    [DatabaseGenerated(DatabaseGeneratedOption.Identity)]
    public int Id { get; } = id;
    [Unique]
    [Column("ProductName")]
    public string Name { get; } = name;
    [Unique("CategoryModel")]
    public int CategoryId { get; set; }
    [Unique("CategoryModel")]
    public string Model { get; set; }
}
[GenerateTable&lt;Product&gt;]
public partial class ProductTable;
</code></pre>
<h4 id="322-generatetable生成代码">3.2.2 GenerateTable生成代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>以下代码可用于CURD操作</li>
<li>使用Name(同类属性)操作实际自动映射到ProductName字段</li>
<li>默认插入和修改忽略Id字段</li>
<li>但是不能用于反向工程生成表</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">using ShadowSql.Identifiers;
partial class ProductTable : Table
{
    public ProductTable(string tableName = "Products") : base(tableName)
    {
        Id = DefineColumn("Id");
        Name = DefineColumn("Name", "ProductName");
        CategoryId = DefineColumn("CategoryId");
        Model = DefineColumn("Model");
        AddInsertIgnore(Id);
        AddUpdateIgnore(Id);
    }

    public IColumn Id { get; }
    public new IColumn Name { get; }
    public IColumn CategoryId { get; }
    public IColumn Model { get; }
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="323-generatetable生成支持反向工程的表结构">3.2.3 GenerateTable生成支持反向工程的表结构</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>只需要再引用ShadowSql.DDL(0.9.2-alpha)即可,配置代码无需修改</li>
<li>生成以下代码</li>
<li>该表结构同样支持CURD操作,还能支持生成Create Table功能</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">using Shadow.DDL.Schemas;
using Shadow.DDL.Constraints;

namespace GenerateSchemaTableTests;
partial class ProductTable : TableSchema
{
    public ProductTable(string tableName = "Products", string schema = "") : base(tableName, [_id, _name, _categoryId, _model], [_categoryModel], schema)
    {
    }

    private static readonly ColumnSchema _id = new ColumnSchema&lt;int&gt;("Id", ColumnType.Identity | ColumnType.Key | ColumnType.NotNull);
    private new static readonly ColumnSchema _name = new ColumnSchema&lt;string&gt;("ProductName", "Name", ColumnType.Unique | ColumnType.NotNull);
    private static readonly ColumnSchema _categoryId = new ColumnSchema&lt;int&gt;("CategoryId", ColumnType.NotNull);
    private static readonly ColumnSchema _model = new ColumnSchema&lt;string&gt;("Model", ColumnType.NotNull);
    private static readonly UniqueConstraint _categoryModel = new UniqueConstraint("CategoryModel", "CategoryId", "Model");
    public ColumnSchema Id =&gt; _id;
    public new ColumnSchema Name =&gt; _name;
    public ColumnSchema CategoryId =&gt; _categoryId;
    public ColumnSchema Model =&gt; _model;
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="324-强制生成322代码">3.2.4 强制生成3.2.2代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>如果引用了ShadowSql.DDL,但是某个功能不允许含Create Table功能</li>
<li>这时可以给待生成的类增加基类Table即可</li>
<li>修改后的配置代码如下</li>
<li>如果设置了基类为Table或TableSchema,则按指定规则生成</li>
<li>无设置如果引用包含ShadowSql.DDL则按TableSchema生成</li>
<li>如果引用包含ShadowSql.Core则按Table生成</li>
<li>都没引用不生成</li>
<li>一年多前就有人评论用SourceGenerator生成代码,现在终于把这块补上了</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">[GenerateTable&lt;Product&gt;]
public partial class ProductTable : Table;
</code></pre>

<h2 id="5-影子编程">5. 影子编程</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>源生成器可以生成一个类的辅助类型(DTO、序列化、表结构等)</li>
<li>这些辅助类型就相当于源类型的影子</li>
<li>把周边功能影子化不仅减少了代码量,还提高了代码的可预测性和内聚性,也提高了代码的可读性。</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>

Hand.GeneratePoco --version 0.2.1.19-alpha<br>
Hand.GenerateConvert --version 0.2.1.17-alpha<br>
ShadowSql.GenerateTable --version 0.9.1.1-alpha</p>
